text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking around the
school
grounds with Inari One...

text_block_list.name: Ambitious Student
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What's with you constantly slacking
off on
your training?!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text:
...Shut up. It doesn't concern you, so
leave me
alone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know those two. They were besties
until a li'l
while ago. Lately they're
constantly scrappin' like
cats and dogs.

text_block_list.name: Ambitious Student
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sick of your tone! If you're not
gonna try,
then what are you doing here
at Tracen
Academy?!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text: I don't have to explain myself to you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh! Think I'd better step in.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hold up, you two! What's with
all the
fightin'?

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text: Inari... please stay out of this.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No can do. Just look around ya! The
storm you
two've been stirrin' up has got
folks worried.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That said, we can't just leave this
unfinished, eh?
How 'bout you let the
great Inari deal with this
fight?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day, as Umamusume,
we settle
our disputes by runnin'!

text_block_list.name: Ambitious Student
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't have said it better myself!
There's no
way I'm gonna lose to
someone who's always
skipping training!

text_block_list.name: Ambitious Student
text_block_list.text:
How about it? Don't tell me you're too
scared!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Fine.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, Trainer? Who's most
likely to
come out the winner?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya think? Well, guess we just gotta
watch and
see.
choice_data_list: Isn't it the one who's training, a...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Much to my surprise, however, it's the

Umamusume who was supposedly
slacking off
who easily takes the win.

text_block_list.name: Ambitious Student
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... D-damn it!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text:
...That's why I didn't want to race
against
you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with the long face? You're
lookin'
pretty glum for someone who just
won.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text: ...I've just entered my race-ready phase.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text:
I was happy at first. I was suddenly
getting so
fast, I had no idea what was
happening to me.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text:
But... I gradually started feeling guilty
each time I
ran.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text:
It felt like I was moving forward alone,
leaving her
behind.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Gotcha.
Well, your partner here
poured her heart out to
ya. What's your
response?

text_block_list.name: Ambitious Student
text_block_list.text:
I knew that already! It was obvious you'd
become
race-ready!

text_block_list.name: Ambitious Student
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'd decided I was gonna catch
up with
you... because I wanted to keep
running with you!

text_block_list.name: Ambitious Student
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep running straight ahead,
like I did
just now! I'll definitely catch up
with you, so you don't need to keep
glancing back!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I've acted so stupidly.
I'll start training
properly again so I can get
faster. I trust that you'll catch up with
me one day.

text_block_list.name: Ambitious Student
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... sniffle... Okay.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Student
text_block_list.text: Inari... thank you for everything!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh. I swear, some folks have got no
idea how
to have a proper fight!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh. I swear, some folks have got no
idea how
to have a proper fight!
choice_data_list: It's the result of clashing with e...
It's the result of clashing with e...
You wrapped that up in no time flat!
You wrapped that up in no time flat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Exactly. Well, it woulda been a helluva lot easier if they opened up from the get-go.
choice_data_list: It's the result of clashing with e...
It's the result of clashing with e...
You wrapped that up in no time flat!
You wrapped that up in no time flat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But then, they woulda never gotten to
buttin'
heads and experiencin' the
essence of a fight!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And remember, if we ever go toe-to-toe, make sure to bring your A game!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A bold approach to solving
problems—that's Inari
One for you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aw, quit it with the flattery. I only gave
'em a li'l
push in the right direction!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty. Seein' them run's got me all
fired up!
Think I'll hit the track and run a
lap too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Inari One dashes off with a
bashful
look on her face.
